title: Navy intelligence visits Frances Swan

tellings.quote: and then Navy intelligence picks up on this woman and they go and visit her in 1954

plain: In 1954, Navy intelligence officers are said to have taken notice of a woman named Frances Swan in Eliot, Maine, and gone to visit her. A researcher named Grant Cameron tells this in his own summary, pointing to a record about her from the FBI, the US federal police, and Navy intelligence. If true, it would show the military took a private woman's claims seriously enough to look into them in person.
